title: HASONEFILTER on an unfiltered column that has a single value

source.quote: HASONEFILTER corresponds to the following code: COUNTROWS ( FILTERS ( <ColumnName> ) ) = 1
source.supports: HASONEFILTER counts the directly filtered values

source.quote: Filter on one column does not affect other columns, -- which are cross-filtered but not filtered.
source.supports: the page shows FILTERS returning every value of a column that has no direct filter

derivation: With no direct filter FILTERS returns all the values of the column (the page shows all 8 categories for an unfiltered column). Param[Value] has one value, so COUNTROWS ( FILTERS ( ... ) ) = 1 is TRUE.
alternative: The description "TRUE when the number of directly filtered values on ColumnName is one" can be read as needing a direct filter. In that reading the result is FALSE, because the column is not filtered.
